name: Football Club / Agent (AMLR obliged from 2029)
description: Football clubs and player agents — AMLR obliged from 2029 under the AMLR transition. Build the architecture early so clubs and agents can adopt before the deadline. Focus: player-transfer payments, agent commissions, sponsor / shareholder UBO, third-party ownership.

recommends_fcp_domains.rationale: Mandatory from 2029 — start the architecture now.
Sponsor / shareholder UBO screening; cross-border transfer payments.
Inflated transfer fees, agent-commission overpayments, kickbacks.
Public-sector interface (stadium permits, regional grants); FIFA / UEFA governance.
